query: NVIDIA Data Center revenue Q4 fiscal 2027
normalized: 2027 center data fiscal nvidia q4 revenue

output.content:
NVIDIA has not yet reported Q4 fiscal 2027 Data Center revenue; Q4 FY2027 ends in late January 2027 and would be reported after the quarter closes. [[1]] 

NVIDIA also does not provide standalone Data Center revenue guidance: its latest disclosed outlook is **total company revenue of $108.0 billion ±2% for Q3 FY2027**, while explicitly assuming no Data Center compute revenue from China. [[2]] 

For context, the latest reported Data Center revenue was **$89.0 billion in Q2 FY2027**, up 18% sequentially and 117% year over year. [[2]]
